00D5EA.name: Mario X speed on ground, jump start
summary: Handles Mario's horizontal movement and the start of a jump. Starts a normal or spin jump when B or A is pressed, sets the Y speed
from the X speed, turns Mario around, picks the max speed/acceleration from the slope, run state and direction, and adds acceleration
or deceleration to Mario X speed ([$7A]/[RAM_MarioSpeedX]). Also updates the dash timer [$13E4] (P-meter).
Contains several tables: dash timer steps, cape-flight slope values, spin jump timer values. Part of the DATA at $00D5EA is the end of the autoslide speed table.

s00D7A5.name: Table: Y acceleration (gravity)
summary: Added to Mario Y speed each frame by state; index 3+ is used by cape flight phases.

s00D7B9.name: Table: cape and Yoshi wings float limits

s00D7C8.name: Table: cape flight max fall speed

CapeSpeed.name: Cape flight phase tables, then Mario Y speed
summary: CapeSpeed: phase step by pitch input. $00D7D4: target phase. $00D7D9: takeoff boost table.
Code from $00D7E4: Mario Y physics. Adds gravity, limits fall speed, handles cape takeoff and the 6 cape flight phases ([$1407]),
and floating with cape/winged Yoshi. Pitch input is set by held direction relative to facing; dash button released stops flight.
$00D94F: picks the takeoff boost [$1409] from the fall speed. $00D968/$00D96A: updates the dash timer [$13E4], capped at $70.

s00D980.name: Table: swim poses and Y speed limits

s00D988.name: Swimming physics and controls
summary: Mario movement in water: disables sliding, ducking, cape and spin jump. B/A paddles upward, down sinks faster, the layer 3 tide
pushes Mario, and the horizontal speed is limited by a reduced max speed set. Also picks the swim pose and cape animation.
$00DAA9: plays the swim sound and sets the swim animation bit.
